problem: Pricing, checkout and portal capabilities can drift when plan names, limits and service bundles are defined in separate places.
decision: Use config/commercial-offers-v1.json as the public commercial catalog, persist matching SaaS entitlements server-side, and gate Portal V2 with the same plan codes.
prevention: Do not publish a SaaS price or feature unless the corresponding entitlement exists server-side.
Do not expose portal capabilities as included when the plan access model marks them as an upgrade.
Consulting and workshops may grant temporary SaaS access, but this must name the exact plan level and duration.
Checkout plan codes must match canonical commercial plan codes.
root_cause: Commercial packaging had evolved faster than the original Control/Scale entitlement model, so the website, checkout and portal could express different product truths.
